title: Software Engineer (Backend) - WWE Champions
description:
Scopely is looking for a
**Software Engineer (Backend)**
to join the team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis!
  
  
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
  
  
WWE Champions is our ultimate and unique RPG puzzle match game featuring WWE superstars and legends across mobile and PC platforms. WWE Champions is the most downloaded WWE game to date, with a highly engaged and passionate community
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a Software Engineer, you will build and maintain backend systems that power core gameplay and live-service operations. Working within an established Python and Django codebase, you will deliver features, investigate issues, and improve the reliability and performance of a live game. You will collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners, taking ownership of scoped work from implementation through testing and release.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and maintain backend features supporting gameplay, live events, progression, rewards, social features, and platform capabilities.
* Build and update APIs, game logic, background jobs, caching, persistence, and internal operational tools.
* Extend existing systems with readable, maintainable code that follows established patterns.
* Write automated tests and work with QA to validate functionality, edge cases, and regression risks.
* Investigate bugs and production issues using code, logs, and available monitoring tools, collaborating with teammates on fixes.
* Contribute improvements to performance, reliability, observability, and code quality.
* Work with product, design, QA, analytics, and other engineers to clarify requirements and deliver features.
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions, incorporating feedback and sharing what you learn.
* Identify technical debt and operational risks, communicate concerns, and contribute to prioritized improvements.
* Support releases and live operations by validating changes, monitoring outcomes, and escalating issues when needed.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Experience & Technical Skills**

* 2+ years of professional software development experience, preferably working on backend services or applications.
* Proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming.
* Experience building or maintaining backend services and RESTful APIs using Django or a comparable framework.
* Understanding of data modeling, database access patterns, and the role of caching in backend applications.
* Familiarity with relational or NoSQL databases; experience with DynamoDB or Redis is a plus.
* Understanding of background jobs, scheduled tasks, and common failure scenarios such as retries and duplicate processing.
* Ability to read unfamiliar code, trace application behavior, and debug issues methodically.
* Experience writing automated tests, using version control, and participating in code reviews.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and practical software design principles.
* Familiarity with Docker and cloud services, particularly AWS, is a plus.

**Cross-Functional and Game-Specific Knowledge**

* Ability to collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teammates to clarify requirements and deliver reliable features.
* Awareness of how backend correctness and performance affect users, particularly when handling progression, rewards, or other persistent state.
* Willingness to learn an existing game’s systems, business rules, and live operations workflows.
* Experience with games, live-service products, game-client integrations such as Unity, or analytics and operational tooling is a plus.
* Comfortable working iteratively, communicating progress and blockers, and adapting as requirements become clearer.

**Soft Skills & Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to explain your approach, ask questions, and document relevant decisions.
* Ownership of assigned work, including testing, follow-through, and timely escalation of risks or blockers.
* A collaborative approach, openness to feedback, and willingness to learn from others.
* Interest in games, player experience, and building reliable live services.

**About Us**
At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!
  
  
**About Scopely**
Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
  
  
Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
  
  
Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.
  
  
Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.
  
  
Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
description:
**Description**
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.
  
  
Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
  
  
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.
  
  
Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.
  
  
AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
  
  
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.
  
  
Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally
* Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually

**Our Tenets**

* Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights
* Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses
* No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Hyderabad, IN - Analytical Instruments Group, Materials & Structural Analysis Division
  
  
**About the product: The Thermo Scientific™ Metrios™ is an advanced TEM imaging system designed to automate and optimize imaging workflows. With the Metrios™ AX, we introduced the world's first commercially available Scanning Transmission Electron Microscope (S/TEM) using machine learning for automated, high-quality data collection. Exclusively designed for the semiconductor industry, the Metrios series removes automation barriers, enabling labs to measure critical dimensions of semiconductor devices during development and manufacturing.**
**How will you make an impact?**
We're seeking a Software Engineer to join our TEM Semiconductor value stream, driving the development of innovative 4D-STEM and Image Processing solutions for semiconductor metrology workflows. As a member of a distributed agile Scrum team, you will collaborate closely with teams in the Netherlands and Czech Republic. You'll develop high-performance software primarily in Python, with contributions in C# and Rust, to process, analyze, and visualize large-scale microscopy datasets. The ideal candidate brings experience in scientific computing, numerical methods, and performance optimization, with the ability to leverage CPU and GPU resources for computationally intensive workloads. Experience with TypeScript is a plus for contributing to user-facing applications.
  
  
**What will you do?**
You will be part of the TEM organization within Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Materials and Structural Analysis R&D organization, which is committed to bringing game-changing solutions to our customers to help them achieve success.
  
  
You will be based in Hyderabad, IN, and report to the Functional Group Lead.
  
  
In this role, you'll collaborate with developers, product owners, architects, and other stakeholders, uniting multi-site teams to deliver reliable and secure software solutions. Your responsibilities include:
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance software solutions for advanced 4D-STEM applications.
* Develop image-processing software and libraries to support advanced microscopy and metrology applications.
* Develop scientific and computational software using Python, contributing to data acquisition, processing, analysis, and visualization workflows.
* Write and maintain high-quality unit tests, integration tests, and system-level component tests to ensure software reliability and performance.
* Participate in code reviews, promoting software quality, maintainability, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects, performance bottlenecks, and computational challenges.
* Apply scientific computing and numerical methods to microscopy and metrology challenges, leveraging CPU and GPU acceleration to process, analyze, and optimize large-scale 4D-STEM data workflows.
* Stay current with advancements in scientific computing, high-performance computing, numerical methods, and software engineering practices.
* Learn TEM, 4D-STEM, and semiconductor metrology domain knowledge and validate software solutions using experimental and simulated datasets.

**How will you get here?**
The ideal candidate for this position enjoys working in a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural environment to address software challenges. If you enjoy the development of software solutions on top of high-performance systems, this is an excellent opportunity. The successful candidate will possess the following combination of education and experience:
  
  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, with expertise in software development.

**Experience:**

* 5 + years of Strong software development experience in Python; experience with C#, Rust is a plus.
* Experience developing scientific and computational software in Windows environments.
* Knowledge of numerical methods, linear algebra, and scientific computing concepts used in data analysis and computational applications.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, including object-oriented design, testing, code reviews.
* Experience with scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, CuPy or similar frameworks.
* Experience with image processing and analysis techniques, preferably using libraries such as OpenCV, scikit-image, or similar scientific imaging frameworks.
* Experience processing and analyzing large-scale datasets and developing performant computational workflows.
* Knowledge of concurrent and parallel programming, including multithreading, multiprocessing, and asynchronous processing.
* Experience leveraging CPU and GPU acceleration technologies, including CUDA or equivalent frameworks, for computationally intensive workloads.
* Experience writing and maintaining unit tests, integration tests, and system-level tests.
* Familiarity with TypeScript and modern web technologies is a plus.

We're seeking a versatile GenAI Engineer who can work across the full stack of GenAI applications, from model integration and prompt engineering to building intuitive user interfaces. * Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models and forecasting algorithms
* Write comprehensive tests including unit tests, integration tests, and prompt regression suites
* Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions
* Stay current with GenAI research and tools, evaluating new models and techniques for potential adoption

* Experience with prompt engineering, RAG systems

* Experience with model serving frameworks (vLLM, TensorRT, Ray)

* Familiarity with Anaplan or similar enterprise planning platforms
* Experience with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks for AI features
* Contributions to open-source ML projects or research publications
* Experience with model observability tools (LangSmith, W&B, MLflow)

* Lead a greenfield team building transformative AI capabilities from the ground up
* Work on cutting-edge conversational and agentic AI technologies
* Build user-facing AI features that directly impact how businesses plan and make decisions
* Experiment with the latest GenAI models and techniques
* Collaborate with talented engineers, data scientists, and product designers
* Solve unique challenges at the intersection of AI and enterprise software
* Grow your skills in both ML engineering and full-stack development

title: ServiceNow - Senior Application Developer
description:
**Your Mission:**

Take end-to-end ownership of our ServiceNow platform customization and ongoing improvement, with a strong focus on ITSM and ITOM. You will partner closely with IT and HR stakeholders to deliver scalable, upgrade-safe solutions that align with ServiceNow best practices—knowing when to configure vs. customize, and having the confidence and communication skills to push back when a request would create unnecessary technical debt. As a senior member of the team, you will shape how we build on ServiceNow: establishing maintainable patterns, improving automation, ensuring data quality in the CMDB, and integrating ServiceNow with other enterprise services via REST/APIs. You will help keep the platform clean, secure, and operationally reliable across environments.

**What You’ll Do**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain ServiceNow solutions across ITSM and ITOM using configuration-first, upgrade safe patterns.
* Build and improve workflows and automations (Flow Designer, approvals, routing, fulfillment, notifications) with a focus on reliability and reuse.
* Own and evolve ITOM capabilities (e.g., Discovery, Service Mapping, Event/Operations integrations) and improve the quality and usefulness of operational data.
* Advise on best practices for CMDB health and data model discipline (e.g., CSDM-aligned thinking, CI relationships, lifecycle hygiene) in collaboration with platform/process owners.
* Operate a safe delivery lifecycle across Dev/Test/Prod: versioning, controlled transports, documentation, and release readiness.
* Apply security-by-design (roles, ACLs, least privilege) and contribute to ongoing platform hygiene and governance.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across UI, scripting, integrations, performance, and data integrity; resolve quickly and implement preventive fixes.

**Strategic Responsibilities**

* Set and enforce development standards (scoped apps, reusable components, documentation expectations, and “don’t customize what the platform already does well”).
* Help shape the ServiceNow roadmap with IT and HR: prioritize work, reduce technical debt.
* Improve integration and automation maturity (API design, error handling, monitoring, retry patterns, and runbooks).
* Support platform governance (instance health checks, release readiness, structured upgrade planning/testing).
* Coach stakeholders and peers to raise platform literacy and reduce “snowflake” requests through clear guidance and tradeoff communication.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience in production environments, owning enhancements from design through deployment.
* Certifications (based on scope): CIS-ITSM and ITOM-related (e.g., Discovery / Service Mapping) where applicable.
* Strong ServiceNow platform development skills (JavaScript/Glide APIs, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, Script Includes, scoped apps, catalog items, workflows).
* Solid ITSM implementation experience (incident/problem/change/request, knowledge, SLAs) and practical delivery history.
* Hands-on ITOM experience (especially Discovery; plus Service Mapping / related ITOM patterns as applicable) and understanding of operational data dependencies.
* Ability to push back constructively: guide stakeholders toward standard, maintainable solutions and explain tradeoffs (upgrade safety, maintainability, licensing, performance).
* Experience with test and release discipline (ATF where appropriate, regression strategy, upgrade-readiness practices).
* Required: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and/or Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* Strong English communication skills and comfort working across IT and HR teams with varying technical depth.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in an Agile environment; SAFe exposure is a plus.
* Experience with identity/group governance integrations (e.g., Entra-based group sync concepts) and role/permission hygiene at scale.
* Exposure to ServiceNow platform operating model topics (instance strategy, release management, operational support, platform reviews/health assessments).
* Experience supporting service catalog / service portfolio management concepts and related roles/workflows.
* Available to work on-site in Noida at least 60%, or willingness to relocate.

**What We Offer**

Want to join a team that enjoys making secure connectivity simple for our customers? You’ll be among people who believe in:

* Caring PASSIONATELY about keeping our customers safe – We’re dedicated to solving problems. Whatever it takes.
* Thinking UNCONVENTIONALLY to stay ahead – The world never fails to surprise us. So let’s surprise it first.
* Doing the hard work to make things SIMPLE – Craft and hone something that delights in its simplicity.
* Working COLLABORATIVELY to build success – The power of the team will always make us faster and better.

As a testament to this, Open Systems has been recognized as an outstanding place to work. You’ll be surrounded by smart teams who enrich your experience and provide opportunities you will need to develop your skills and advance your career.

We look forward to receiving your online application (please note that you need to compress your application into two attachments). Only direct applications will be considered.

Come as you are! We are looking for amazing people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. Open Systems welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

**About Open Systems**

Open Systems is about secure connectivity made easy, combining SD-WAN, Firewall, SWG, CASB, and ZTNA into a framework that supports secure connectivity across cloud and hybrid environments and locations. Open Systems Managed SASE provides a comprehensive SASE solution through an easy-to-use customer portal, underpinned with a unified data platform to drive future innovation, all delivered as a 24x7 managed service.

title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Senior Flutter Developer - Job Description

Role overview

Repalogic is hiring a Senior Flutter Developer (5+ years) to own consumer and business apps across the TYRIOS mobile ecosystem, from prototype to App Store and Google Play release.

What makes the role interesting: an AI-assisted CRM with call recording, transcripts and summaries, and a shared multi-app platform where common packages power many apps.

Job Title : Senior Flutter Developer

Company: Repalogic

Platform: TYRIOS (CRM, PIM, Portfolio apps)

Experience: 5+ Years in Mobile Development

Employement Type: Full- Time

Loction: Hybrid

About the role

You will build and maintain the TYRIOS mobile apps for Android and iOS: GYO, GYO Business, CRM, PIM, Inventory, Portfolio, Workhub and eCash. You take features from prototype and product documentation through development, testing and release.

The apps live in a Flutter monorepo using pub workspaces with Melos, with shared packages, BLoC state management, the repository pattern and offline support with local storage (Hive). You integrate backend REST APIs with role-based user rights, and you own publishing to Google Play and the App Store.

As a senior engineer, you set technical direction for the mobile codebase, review code, and mentor other developers.

Key responsibilities

Feature delivery

• Turn prototypes and product docs (PRDs) into technical plans, estimates and shipped features across consumer and business apps.

• Build polished, responsive and accessible UIs that behave consistently on Android and iOS.

• Work with product managers, designers, backend engineers and QA from requirement to release.

Architecture and code quality

• Design and maintain a clean, layered architecture using BLoC, the repository pattern and dependency injection via controllers and providers.

• Own the Flutter monorepo (pub workspaces with Melos): structure shared packages, manage versioning and keep cross-app code reusable.

• Lead code reviews, define coding standards, and reduce technical debt.

API integration and security

• Integrate backend REST APIs through the shared HTTP layer, including authentication, token refresh, error handling and pagination.

• Implement role-based access and user rights so screens, actions and data respect each user's permissions.

• Store credentials securely and protect customer data on the device in line with data protection rules (GDPR).

Offline support

• Build offline support with local storage (Hive) and caching where each app needs it.

• Handle retry queues, sync after reconnect and connectivity changes.

Native platform work

• Configure and maintain native Android (Gradle, Kotlin) and iOS (Xcode, Swift, CocoaPods/SPM) projects.

• Write platform channels or plugins where Flutter packages fall short, and manage permissions, push notifications, deep links, in-app purchases and flavors.

Testing and release

• Write and maintain unit, widget, BLoC, golden, accessibility and integration tests.

• Set up and own CI/CD pipelines for build, test, signing and distribution.

• Manage releases to Google Play and the App Store, including signing, store listings, review compliance, staged rollouts and hotfixes.

• Monitor crashes, performance and app health after release with Sentry and Firebase Crashlytics, and fix issues fast.

Leadership

• Mentor junior and mid-level developers and share knowledge across the team. • Contribute to technical decisions, documentation and the mobile roadmap.

• Work effectively with AI coding tools and help the team use them well.

Required skills and qualifications

• 5+ years of professional mobile development, including 3+ years building production Flutter apps.

• Apps shipped and maintained on both Google Play and the App Store.

• Strong Dart, including null safety, async programming and streams.

• BLoC/Cubit and clean architecture, including the repository pattern.

• REST API integration with http (Dio a plus) and auth flows such as OAuth2/JWT.

• Local storage and offline support (e.g. Hive), including sync after reconnect. • Native Android and iOS setup: Gradle, Xcode, signing, provisioning profiles, flavors and platform channels.

• Automated testing: unit, widget and BLoC tests.

• Clear written and spoken English.

Nice to have

• Consumer apps like GYO: onboarding, push notifications, in-app purchases, maps and location.

• Business apps such as CRM, PIM (product information management) or portfolio/asset management.

• AI or speech features, such as call recording, transcription or summaries.

• Flutter monorepos using pub workspaces with Melos.

• Role-based access control in complex, multi-role apps.

• CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Codemagic, Bitrise or Fastlane.

• Advanced Dart: isolates and code generation with json\\_serializable and freezed. • Native development in Kotlin or Swift beyond setup work.

• Monitoring with Sentry and Firebase (Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging).

• Localisation, accessibility and theming for multi-brand apps.

• Performance profiling with Flutter DevTools.

• German language skills. • Contributions to open-source Flutter packages.
